purpose: Evidence-first cross-contour diagnostic rules. Not legal conclusions.

rules.trigger: Construction debris or excavated material is used to fill, level or improve a site.
questions: What material and from which operation?
Who owns or uses the receiving plot?
What is the actual destination and purpose?
Is the material documented and physically traceable?
rules.red_flag: Calling debris useful fill without evidence of lawful material status and actual handling.

rules.trigger: Removal or relocation of fertile soil layer.
questions: Where and how was it reused?
Are there project/site records and physical traces?
rules.red_flag: Earthworks documents omit separate accounting for fertile soil layer.

rules.trigger: Equipment, structures or vessels are dismantled, cut or demolished.
questions: Where could releases reach soil, stormwater or water?
Who controls the site and contractor?
rules.red_flag: Assuming an idle asset contains no environmental hazards.

notes: Existing permanent radar IDs reused; no new radar IDs created. Source documents and current NPA must be checked before ACTIVE.
